title: eval lane charter: the ask-accuracy round counts read 30 / 150, but the set is now 55 questions (55 / 275)
body:
repo:cloud#5 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjPP1zuWBNq3nBXVei9

Found by the cloud os-dev agent on objectstack-ai/cloud PR #4561 (card cloud#4552, epic cloud#3825). Class b. The file is governed (`.claude/**`), so a human merges it.

## What happens

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/eval.md:23` (objectstack main b76df9a6980) reads 「题次:首次每题 1 次(30 轮);正式基线每题 5 次(150 轮)」. The cloud ask-accuracy set was 42 questions and is 55 after PR #4561, so the counts should read 55 rounds for the first pass and 275 for the formal baseline. The ruled baseline budget on cloud#3825 (comment 6891405039) is "the full set at the time"; the run cards are cloud#4550 (trial) and cloud#4555 (formal).

## Change

Update the line so it names the set by reference (for example, "the current ask-accuracy set × 1 / × 5") or gives 55 / 275. A reference avoids drift on the next addition.
